source_file: 03 Statistic/01 定性资料/02 率差的置信区间计算/Newcombe_wilson.sas
notes: Second (non-0%/100%) section of Newcombe_wilson.sas: the author's own hand-rolled Newcombe-Wilson risk-difference CI formula (PROBIT + manual Wilson bounds in a DATA step chain) cross-checked against PROC FREQ BINOMIAL(cl=wilson) and TABLES riskdiff(cl=newcombe) on the trial-arm event datalines. Added one PROC PRINT (not in the original, which only builds _newcombeCI without printing it) so the manually computed d/L/U are visible in the listing; everything else is unmodified.
